name: PandaScore
tagline: Esports data API for scores, fixtures, and stats across major titles
description: PandaScore provides real-time and historical esports data including live scores, match schedules, player and team stats, and tournament information for League of Legends, Counter-Strike, Dota 2, Valorant, and other competitive games via a REST API.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer header or token query parameter; self-serve signup at app.pandascore.co

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier available with limited request quota; exact limits vary by plan — confirm on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans for higher rate limits and premium data access

rate_limits: Published per-plan; free tier lower than paid
use_cases: get upcoming esports matches for a game
fetch live match scores and status
search teams and players by name
